findings.motion: SB 10 - Culp - 3rd Reading: Bill Passed (roll call 340)
findings.note: IN House, SB 10 - Culp - 3rd Reading: Bill Passed (roll call 340), 2025-04-01: yea (tally 66–26); census gate: none.

findings.passage: When voting before or on Election Day, voters must present a valid photo ID.
findings.note: Sentence in a House caucus press release issued in his name, urging early in-person voting. It states the existing Indiana photo ID rule as a plain fact and does not call for any change. The same release encourages voters to return mail-in ballots quickly.

findings.passage: To register, Indiana residents must be at least 18 years old on or before Nov. 3, have a valid Indiana Driver's License or Indiana State Identification Card, be a citizen of the United States, have lived in the same precinct for at least 30 days before Nov. 3, and not be currently imprisoned after being convicted of a crime. Those who do not have a driver's license or state ID can register to vote in person at county government centers, public assistance offices and when completing a Bureau of Motor Vehicles transaction.
findings.note: Paragraph in a House caucus press release issued in his name, listing registration requirements (ID number, citizenship) and where people without a license or state ID can register. It describes existing rules and does not call for any change.
subjects: registering without a driver's license or state ID
